name: Lyra
source:
Lyra represents the darker side to Neus' personality, and the reason why Neus is so indecisive towards Neron out of fear that she may hurt him.

Lyra isn't afraid of showing off her affection for Neron, though she does struggle with suppressing her more violent tendencies.
